subject.title: feat(ios): add Listen action speaking assistant messages via gateway TTS

question: Should the iOS Listen action land as the iOS half of the canonical mobile Listen feature once device proof and changelog cleanup are done, or should mobile Listen pause for broader voice UX direction?
rationale: This is a new user-facing mobile feature tied to a maintainer-labeled canonical issue and a newly landed gateway method, so implementation correctness alone cannot settle product acceptance.

options.title: Land after proof and cleanup
options.body: Keep the PR open, require redacted iOS playback/fallback proof and removal of the app changelog edit, then review it as the iOS implementation for the canonical Listen feature.

options.title: Pause mobile Listen
options.body: Hold this PR and the sibling Android work until maintainers settle the mobile voice UX and gateway TTS rollout direction.

recommendation.title: Land after proof and cleanup
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require redacted iOS playback/fallback proof and removal of the app changelog edit, then review it as the iOS implementation for the canonical Listen feature.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current stacked gateway/iOS proposal and has the strongest recent history on the relevant iOS shared-chat and gateway TTS paths.
